stem: A facility changes to a new batch of nominally similar media and immediately sees a different dryback pattern under the same irrigation schedule. What is the strongest response?
choices: Keep the previous schedule because media sold under the same product name should have comparable physical behavior
Increase nutrient concentration until the new batch reaches the previous dryback rate under the existing schedule
Characterize the new media's water-holding and drainage behavior and adjust irrigation from measured performance
Reduce irrigation monitoring during the transition so normal batch-to-batch variation can stabilize on its own
rationale: Media with similar labels can differ in physical behavior. Actual water retention, drainage, and crop response should be measured before assuming the previous irrigation schedule remains appropriate.
